cards.title: High-Pressure Fuel Pump (HPFP)
cards.body: The N54's high-pressure fuel pump is a documented wear item — we inspect and, where required, replace as part of the rebuild.

cards.title: Injectors
cards.body: Fuel injectors are inspected and, where required, replaced — a documented N54 component that benefits from attention during a full rebuild.

cards.title: Turbochargers
cards.body: The N54's twin turbocharger setup is inspected and, where required, replaced as part of the rebuild.

cards.title: Valve Cleaning
cards.body: Carbon buildup on intake valves is a documented characteristic of the N54's direct-injection design — cleaning is included as part of the rebuild inspection process.
